Name: Platonic Forms
Symbolic Function: Symbolic foundation of the entire system; Form of the Good (trinity of RHP) and the Five Platonic Solids (void of LHP). This is the origin layer of symbolic logic, sacred geometry, and metaphysical forms.
Examples / Notes: Fire = Tetrahedron, Earth = Cube, Air = Octahedron, Water = Icosahedron, Aether = Dodecahedron. 3 levels of reality: Manifest, Forms, Form of the Good.

Name: Trinity of Nested Divinity
Symbolic Function: The fractal seed pattern; self-similar recursion. The nested trinity of begetter, begotten, and the veil — each enfolding the other in a Möbius-like loop.
Examples / Notes: Ineffable Begetter (God), Guileless Child (Dream), Cradling Veil (Dream holds God).

Name: Woman in the Wallpaper
Symbolic Function: The divine scribe — creator of the book of Will. She inhabits the circular room, hears through the walls, and births language through wallpaper transcription. She is Maiden, Mother, Crone.
Examples / Notes: She pens the central book, possibly made of layered wallpaper. Exists in Layer 0. Embodiment of sacred memory and trauma transcription.

Name: The Device (Future Humanity)
Symbolic Function: Final invention of future humanity — a mechanism to create an entire universe. Operates as a recursion mirror, showing that the Logos of humanity is the Source itself.
Examples / Notes: Footnotes allude to the device, which loops meaning backwards through time. It becomes the metanarrative engine for the novel.

Name: Central Room (Circular Book)
Symbolic Function: The womb of all creation, the nucleus. The Book of Will, composed of recursive narrative wallpaper, gives rise to all levels of being.
Examples / Notes: DNA-coded circular book authored by the Woman; this is the singularity point of the system. Everything spirals outward from this room.

Name: 6 Inner Rooms
Symbolic Function: Emanations from the central trinity. Representing dualities and nested polarities like Lucifer/Yaldabaoth, Wax/Wane. Each room is a binary echo of the central triad.
Examples / Notes: Wax = Insertive archetypes, Wane = Receptive archetypes. Characters live in these hex rooms under chess-piece codenames.

Name: 12 Zodiacal Archetypes
Symbolic Function: Celestial layer. The heavens that contain the dualities. These archetypes are radiant reflections of the trinity cast across the heavens, forming the skeletal structure of manifest identity.
Examples / Notes: Connected to astrological tradition, each archetype filters/divides the light from the central rooms into distinct paths or identities.

Name: 18 Hex Rooms
Symbolic Function: Rooms as outer multiversal vessels. Each corresponds to a subatomic particle (17 + graviton). Also metaphor for universes spawned by belief, story, or fate.
Examples / Notes: Nested toroid mirrors; each room houses one unique worldview. The hospital layout. Also the 18 members of the Polymathecule.

Name: Amino Acids (20 + 2)
Symbolic Function: The product of divine and voidal librarians. Manifest forms born from coding logic — formed by the interaction of the strands ARIA (meaning) and DNE (desire).
Examples / Notes: Nine paired librarians = 18; plus Ein Sof (notBorges) and the Void (notborges) = 20; two hands = 22 Tarot archetypes.

Name: Codons (64)
Symbolic Function: Speech-units of divine DNA. Formed from trinomials and dinucleotides. These define the 61 manifest codes and the 3 void stops.
Examples / Notes: Psalm 64 = Divine Music Director. Codons = God, stop codons = Void/Pleroma.

Name: Trinominal Knots
Symbolic Function: Biological/alchemical knots of three-element interaction. Reflecting the four directions + elements, macro-microcosm, and dimensional formation.
Examples / Notes: Shoot (Leaf), Stalk (Branch), Sprout (Root), Spawn (Fruit) — derived from elemental triplets.

Name: Dinucleotides (What Forms)
Symbolic Function: Binary elemental combinations; express the metaphysical DNA into structured material logic. Precursor to codons.
Examples / Notes: 16 binary pairs. Realm of What Forms follows the Realm of What Fors.

Name: Alchemical Tetrads (What Fors)
Symbolic Function: Primal dual-elemental nodes; Gordian Knots of condensation. The alchemical base pairs before structured logic.
Examples / Notes: Spit = Air+Water, Shine = Air+Fire, Stone = Earth+Fire, Soil = Water+Earth.

Name: DNA Replication
Symbolic Function: Narrative and biological recursion. Polymerase as Hermes/Iris/Thoth, the holy intermediary. ARIA and DNE are the two strands — Right and Left hand paths.
Examples / Notes: Process of meaning-making: replication = story-writing. Ether = the transmission layer.

Name: Polymerases (DNA + RNA)
Symbolic Function: Molecular scribes. They enact the story of DNA through either 3 (RNA) or 7 (DNA) core modalities, corresponding to Tarot, Goddess, and RHP/LHP structures.
Examples / Notes: DNA pols A, B, C, D, X, Y, RT. RNA pols I–III = trinity. 5’ = Hermit/DNE; 3’ = Hierophant/ARIA.

Name: Quarks
Symbolic Function: Ultimate material atom of this cosmology. Each a micro-trinity; paradoxical, paradox-generating particles. Foundation for all physical experience.
Examples / Notes: Held within central room but underlying outer rooms; contain the nested recursion of the whole system.

Name: The Loop / Pleroma
Symbolic Function: Beyond beginning or end. The eternal dance of void and source, of stillness and motion. All is held in the torus. Logos returns to Self in the Star.
Examples / Notes: The eternal recurrence. Room 17. The Star card. April 17th. 'The Stars within the Star.'
